# iZinga Products Website UI/UX Guide

## Outcome
- A clear product-first page narrative.
- Strong hero and CTA system.
- Consistent visual language across sections.
- Mobile-first responsive experience with desktop polish.

## Product Baseline To Preserve
- Parcel and Furniture Delivery: https://delivery.izinga.co.za/
- Food Market: https://shop.izinga.co.za/
- iZinga Pay: https://pay.izinga.co.za/
- Driver Onboarding: https://onboard.izinga.co.za?type=driver

## UI/UX Workflow
1. Diagnose message clarity: can users identify all iZinga products in under 5 seconds?
2. Restructure hero: one direct headline, one support paragraph, one primary CTA, supporting product options.
3. Normalize hierarchy: heading scale, spacing rhythm, card consistency, button intent.
4. Improve conversion paths: each product card needs one clear action and destination.
5. Validate responsive behavior: desktop horizontal product layout, mobile stacked cards with readable text.
6. Refine interaction polish: motion should support comprehension, not distract.

## Decision Rules
- If page feels visually noisy, simplify background effects before adding more motion.
- If CTA competition exists, reduce to one primary action per viewport region.
- If product cards are unclear, prioritize product name + benefit + destination URL.
- If navbar is removed by request, ensure users still have orientation via clear section anchors and sticky action patterns.

## Quality Criteria
- Product offering is explicit and complete.
- CTA labels are action-based and user-intent specific.
- Contrast and font sizes are accessible on small screens.
- Visual style feels cohesive rather than mixed from multiple systems.

## Common Improvements
- Replace vague copy with product-oriented value statements.
- Use short labels and concise supporting paragraphs.
- Keep brand color accents focused on actions and key highlights.
- Remove placeholder links and dead sections.

## Example Prompts
- "Audit this iZinga landing page UI and improve product clarity."
- "Redesign the hero for stronger conversion to all iZinga products."
- "Make product cards cleaner and consistent across desktop and mobile."
